more_info.overview: Methyl esters of fatty acids is a group name for fatty-acid compounds esterified with methanol. They can be produced by transesterification of fats, and their composition depends on the starting fatty-acid mixture. The group includes individual esters such as methyl palmitate, methyl stearate and methyl oleate. This historical glazing-agent entry does not identify one food-grade product. Industrial uses of these esters do not establish typical food uses or an intake limit.
